Class 6A playoff preview: Highland Park and Carmel in Opening Round
Highland Park and Carmel play in Class 6A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be a blowout.
Highland Park and Carmel play in Class 6A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be a blowout.
The top eight seeds in each of the North and South brackets of the 48-team Class 6A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Libertyville, the No. 4 seed in the North bracket, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 13 Noble/Muchin and No. 20 Noble/UIC in the First Round.
Grant, the No. 5 seed in the North bracket, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 12 Niles Notre Dame and No. 21 Maine West in the First Round.
Lake Zurich, the No. 8 seed in the North bracket, has a bye and plays the winner of No. 9 Burlington Central and No. 24 Rockford East in the First Round.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Friday, Oct. 23
- 6:30 p.m.: North: No. 22 Streamwood (3-6) at No. 11 Highland Park (6-3) (Highland Park 43, Streamwood 13)
- 7 p.m.: North: No. 18 Carmel (3-6) vs. No. 15 Noble/Bulls (4-5) at Hanson Stadium (Carmel 33, Noble/Bulls 22)
Game Capsules
No. 22 Streamwood (3-6) at No. 11 Highland Park (6-3)
Streamwood travels to Highland Park in the Class 6A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 6 Fenwick (6-3) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 6:30 p.m. Friday.
#11 Highland Park (6-3)
Highland Park (6-3) is the No. 11 seed in the 48-team Class 6A field and hosts No. 22 Streamwood in the Opening Round.
Highland Park went 6-3 overall and 3-0 in Central Suburban (Central), scoring 281 points and allowing 225, an average margin of +6.2 a game.
Highland Park went 7-3 last season, including 0-1 in playoffs. Highland Park has reached the playoffs in four of the last 10 seasons.

Enrollment: 1,573
Playoff Appearances: 21 in 52 IHSA Playoff Seasons since 1974 (40 percent)

Prediction: Highland Park 43, Streamwood 13 (Highland Park has a 99% chance to win, according to our model).
No. 18 Carmel (3-6) vs. No. 15 Noble/Bulls (4-5)
Carmel and Noble/Bulls meet at Hanson Stadium in the Class 6A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 2 Geneva (8-1) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 7 p.m. Friday.
#18 Carmel (3-6)
Carmel (3-6) is the No. 18 seed in the 48-team Class 6A field and meets No. 15 Noble/Bulls in the Opening Round. It qualified with a losing record.
Carmel went 3-6 overall and 0-3 in CCL (Orange), scoring 199 points and allowing 226, an average margin of -3.0 a game.
Carmel went 8-3 last season, including 1-1 in playoffs. Carmel has reached the playoffs in four of the last 10 seasons.
